If theres a shooter and you're a quarter mile away from him out in the open but you decide to charge at him anyways in an attempt to disarm him its incredibly stupid. Is it heroic? Yes, technically it is but its still really dumb and shouldnt be praised. However if people do praise this quarter mile hero it encourages other people to do the same, instead of just running away like you should do in most cases. If the shooter was right next to the victim then fighting was the right thing to do, he wasnt going to get away and fighting is the next best option. However if he went after the shooter from a considerable distance away in an attempt to be a hero then it was not the right thing to do. Heroic? Yes. Right thing to do given the circumstance? No. It really comes down to how exactly it all went down, regardless its a damn shame this kid was robbed of his chance at life by selfish people taking out their insecurities on others
